name: cv-sheet
description: Real CV content laid onto landscape sheets (842 x 599) in the Figma CV style: serif section headings, light sans body, a year column, a footer with the page number. Preview layout only: greedy fill by measured height, not an export engine.

props.name: blocks
props.description: [{kind: "heading" | "text", text}]. A text block starting with YYYY<TAB> is a dated row.

props.name: title
props.description: The big title at the top of the first sheet (Figma: CURRICULUM VITAE).

rationale: Read off Figma section CV (frames 328:19147 cover, 328:19319 inner): sheet 842 x 599, 50px side margins, 42px top, 50px footer; Bodoni Moda Bold 28/34 and 20, Karla Light 10/12.7 and 12, black on white; year column 24px with a 16px gap. Type roles have no dis-system tokens yet (dis-system is Inter throughout), so they are component custom properties at the top of style.css, ready to move into tokens/*.json. Font files are not in the repo: the stacks fall back to a serif and Inter. Colors use existing tokens (text-active, object-white-passive, base-0 in light). Staged in local-components until maintainer confirms it goes into dis-system.
a11y_notes: Sheets are a visual preview of the document; headings are real h2/h3 elements and block text is set as text, never as markup. The page footer is decoration of the preview.
